cohort: 17 term neonates born by elective cesarean section and not needing resuscitation
finding: The commencement of air breathing at birth generates unique flow and volume states associated with marked spatiotemporal ventilation inhomogeneity.
mod_finding: Initial crying, more common immediately after birth, created a unique volumetric pattern with delayed midexpiratory gas flow that preserved FRC, especially within the dorsal and right lung regions.
